records.title: Tourism infrastructure in Nalanda and Bhagalpur
details:
(a) whether Government has any specific long-term plan or mega-project under consideration to revive the historical legacy of the ancient Nalanda University and Vikramshila University and to establish Nalanda and Bhagalpur as world-class centres of tourism and knowledge; and
(b) the concrete policy initiatives being undertaken by Government under the 'Swadesh Darshan 2.0' to strengthen basic tourism infrastructure, State-of-the-art research centres and international connectivity in Nalanda and Bhagalpur and to attract tourists and researchers from across the world?

records.title: (clubbed) Atmanirbhar Panchayat Program
details: Clubbed question in this member’s official feed

records.title: Vacant faculty positions in Central Universities in Bihar
details:
(a) the details of faculty vacancies in the Central Universities and Institutions of National Importance such as IITs, NITs and AIIMS located in Bihar; and
(b) the steps being taken to fill up these vacancies and to strengthen the research infrastructure?

records.title: Floating solar power plants in Bihar
details:
(a) the number of applications received and approved so far in Bihar under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana;
(b) the present installed capacity of floating solar power plants and grid-connected rooftop solar systems in Bihar; and
(c) the progress made in the implementation of the PM-KUSUM Scheme for connecting agricultural pumps with solar energy in the State?
GK

records.title: Economic condition and the standard of living of families in Bihar
details:
(a) whether Government is conducting any special survey or statistical study at the grassroots level to ascertain the actual economic condition and standard of living of families across all districts of Bihar; and
(b) the manner in which the information obtained from such surveys is being utilized to formulate more effective and precise welfare schemes for the rural and backward areas of Bihar?

records.title: Measures to boost Makhana exports from Bihar
details:
(a) the new technologies developed through the National Research Centre for Makhana located in Darbhanga to increase the income of Makhana growers; and
(b) Government's proposal to boost Makhana exports from Bihar and to set up cluster-based processing units?

records.title: Migration of skilled and unskilled workers and its socio-economic impact
details:
(a) whether Government has conducted any detailed assessment of the reasons for large-scale migration of skilled and unskilled workers from Bihar to other developed States and its socio-economic impact; and
(b) the special efforts being made by Government to generate new employment opportunities for the State's youth in non-agricultural sectors such as manufacturing, construction and services and to enhance labour force participation given the huge dependence on agriculture in the State?

records.title: Samagra Shiksha and BharatNet projects in Bihar
details:
(a) whether Government is taking any special steps to provide high-speed internet and broadband connectivity to rural and remote Government secondary schools in Bihar under the Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan and BharatNet projects; and
(b) whether the targets for setting up smart classrooms and computer labs (ICT) in Government schools of Bihar are being met within stipulated time and the concrete plan of Government to connect rural children of the State with digital education and to improve the computer-student ratio?

records.title: Expansion of AYUSH wings and dispensaries at CHC and PHC levels
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that AYUSH medical facilities are presently available in 36 district hospitals of Bihar, whereas such facilities at the Community Health Centre (CHC) and Primary Health Centre (PHC) levels are currently nil; and
(b) if so, whether the Ministry is considering to provide any special financial package or additional budgetary support to Government of Bihar under the National AYUSH Mission (NAM) for the phase wise expansion of AYUSH wings and dispensaries at the CHC and PHC levels in all blocks of the State?

records.title: Availability of wheelchairs, e-rickshaws and battery-operated buggies at airports
details:
(a) the number of wheelchairs, e-rickshaws and battery-operated buggies available for the convenience of passengers at various airports across the country and specifically at Delhi's Terminal-1, Terminal-2 and Terminal-3 and the details thereof; and
(b) whether any standards have been prescribed by Government regarding the availability and operation of the said facilities and the steps taken for improvement based on their availability, usage and passenger complaints during the last three years and the details thereof?

records.title: Decline in number of textile manufacturing factories in Bihar
Impact recycling of electronic goods
details:
(a) whether Government has any updated national level data on the adverse impacts on the environment and public health caused by illegal recycling units of the total e-waste generated annually in the country; and
(b) the concrete and integrated action plan being implemented by Government to strictly enforce e-waste management rules, strengthen Extended Producers Responsibility (EPR) and ensure the safe collection and recycling of obsolete electronic goods in the country?

records.title: (clubbed) Implementation of the New Criminal Laws
details: Clubbed question in this member’s official feed

records.title: Assistance for modernization of fire services in Bihar
details:
(a) whether any concrete progress has been made in the establishment of new fire stations and the procurement of modern equipment in Bihar following the Central assistance sanctioned under the scheme for expansion and modernisation of Fire Services in the States; and
(b) the steps being taken by Government to train fire service personnel, home guards and local volunteers in Bihar in State-of-the-Art techniques and to improve disaster management preparedness in view of the increasing incidents of fire across the country?

records.title: Tourism, local employment and regional economy in Bihar through National Waterway-1 (Ganga river)
details:
(a) the progress of the 'Cruise Bharat Mission' so far in promoting cruise passenger traffic and the strategies being adopted to link Bihar's Ganga river cruise circuits with maritime and island circuits under the integrated national plan; and 
(b) the plans of Government to assess the long-term impact of this mission on tourism, local employment and the regional economy in Bihar through National Waterway-1 (Ganga river)?

records.title: Waqf properties registered on the UMEED portal
details:
(a) the State-wise list of Waqf properties registered on the UMEED central portal across the country including the State of Bihar and the additional time granted to the States for uploading the relevant documents; and
(b) the number of Waqf properties under illegal occupation in the State of Bihar out of the cases of illegal encroachment detected across the country and the stringent measures being taken by the Central Government to free these lands from the land mafia?

records.title: Regions affected by the overflow of the Kosi, Gandak, and Bagmati rivers
details:
(a) whether Government have any centralized data regarding the massive annual losses suffered by farmers across all flood-affected areas of the State of Bihar including Saharsa, Supaul, Darbhanga, Madhubani, Muzaffarpur, Purnia and Katihar—due to the overflowing of the Kosi, Gandak and Bagmati rivers; and
(b) whether Government is implementing any special central package or permanent flood control action plan for these specific districts of Bihar to safeguard the livelihoods of farmers and protect cultivable land in these areas, which are highly prone to severe flooding, river erosion and waterlogging?

records.title: Special Economic Zones in Bihar
details:
(a) the number of Special Economic Zones (SEZs) established or approved so far in Bihar and if not, whether a single Special Economic Zone is fully operational in the State, the technical and administrative reasons therefor; and 
(b) the current progress of the pending Special Economic Zones proposals for Muzaffarpur, Fatuha or for Makhana and agro-extension in the Mithila region of Bihar and the special budgetary assistance being provided by Government to strengthen the export infrastructure and logistics in this landlocked State?

records.title: Production capacity of horticultural crops in Bihar
Complaints regarding unsolicited commercial communications
details:
(a) whether Government has made any national-level assessment of the financial losses suffered by citizens due to telecom-based digital fraud, in view of increase in complaints regarding unsolicited commercial communications to more than 31 lakh across the country during 2025; and
(b) the time-bound steps being taken by Government to make additional preventive measures, such as re-verification of KYC documents and disconnection of connections of suspected spammers, fully effective across the country under the directions issued by TRAI on 27 February 2026?

records.title: Power generation through nuclear energy and other clean sources
details:
(a) whether Government has any proposal to estabish a nuclear power plant or undertake a feasibility study for setting up such a project in the State of Bihar, as part of its policy to augment power generation through nuclear energy and other clean energy sources; and
(b) the specific policy measures being taken by Government to ensure Bihar's participation in the target of increasing the country's total nuclear power capacity to 22,800 MW by the year 2031-32, and to provide a clean and uninterrupted power supply to the State?

records.title: Branch of the Bharatiya Beej Sahakari Samiti Limited in Bihar
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that no formal branch office of the Bharatiya Beej Sahakari Samiti Limited (BBSSL) has been established in Bihar, if so, the manner in which seed distribution to farmers and monitoring of seed production activities are being carried out through the local cooperative societies in the State; and
(b) the steps being taken to ensure timely payment and better remunerative prices to farmers in Bihar for their seed produce, as well as to ensure the timely availability of affordable, high-quality seeds across all districts of the State?
J

records.title: Use of agricultural residue and organic waste for compressed biogas in Bihar
details:
(a) the total number of proposals received from the State of Bihar for setting up Compressed Biogas (CBG) or bio-energy plants using agricultural residues and organic waste; and
(b) if no such proposals or very few proposals are received, the corrective steps Government is taking to attract rural entrepreneurs to promote bio-energy projects?

records.title: Establishment of critical care blocks under PM-ABHIM in Bihar
details:
(a) the total number of districts in Bihar for which the establishment of Critical Care Blocks have been approved under Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) and the number of districts for which the proposals are currently pending; and
(b) the main reasons for the delay in approving or establishing these Critical Care Blocks in the said districts and by when this emergency facility would be made fully operational for critically ill patients across all districts of the State?

records.title: Cancer treatment of non-pensioner ESM of all ranks and their dependants
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that non-pensioner Ex-Servicemen (ESM) of all ranks and their dependants are provided financial assistance of only up to ?75,000 per annum for cancer treatment, if so, whether, in view of the exorbitant cost of cancer treatment, there is any proposal to enhance this grossly inadequate amount; and
(b) whether, due to this inadequate amount of financial assistance, economically weaker Ex-Servicemen are facing serious hardships such as being compelled to discontinue their cancer treatment midway, and whether Government proposes to ensure 100 per cent cashless treatment for them?

records.title: Modern systems like CAT-I or ILS in Patna, Gaya, and Darbhanga
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to low visibility in winters, dozens of flights get cancelled at Patna, Gaya, and Darbhanga airports; and 
(b) if so, whether Government will provide a definite timeline for installing modern systems like CAT-I or ILS at Patna, Gaya, and Darbhanga so that flights do not get cancelled due to weather conditions?

records.title: Impacts of climate change in Bihar
details:
(a) the details of studies conducted/action plans formulated to assess the impact of climate change such as floods, droughts, heatwaves, unpredictable rainfall and crop losses in Bihar during the last five years and the details of projects sanctioned and expenditure incurred under the State Action Plans on Climate Change(SAPCC); and
(b) the details of concrete outcomes achieved through these initiatives in strengthening the adaptive capacity of farmers, urban populations and disaster-prone districts in the State and the reasons for not achieving expected progress along with a time-bound future roadmap in this regard?

records.title: Expansion of telecom connectivity in Bihar
details:
(a) the number of mobile towers, 4G/5G sites and Gram Panchayats connected under BharatNet project for expansion of telecom connectivity in Bihar during the last five years, along with district-wise details of current status of network coverage and internet speed in urban and rural areas; and 
(b) the special steps taken to improve the quality of communication services, reduce call drops and bridge the digital divide in remote, flood-affected and backward districts of the State and if the desired improvement has not been achieved, the major reasons therefor along with the time-bound action plan proposed for the same?

records.title: Coaching support for OBC candidates
details:
(a) whether OBC candidates preparing for UPSC/competitive examinations are facing financial constraints, limited scholarships, lack of coaching facilities and difficulties related to income certificates, if so, the steps taken so far to resolve these problems; and
(b) whether the Central Government is considering any new initiative to enhance scholarships, provide free/subsidized coaching, and increase digital study resources for OBC candidates, if so, the details thereof?

records.title: Conservation of indigenous fish species
details:
(a) the present status of conservation of major indigenous fish species such as Rohu, Catla, Mrigal, Kalbasu, Mahseer, Singhi, Mangur etc, found in the country and the number of the species which are declining; and
(b) the number of schemes being implemented by Government for the promotion, breeding, hatchery development and encouragement of farmers/fishermen for these indigenous fish and the benefits received through these schemes so far?

records.title: Registration of Madrasas
Establishment of night shelters
details:
(a) whether Government has taken any positive initiative to establish and expand night shelters in urban and semi-urban areas to protect homeless people from cold, heat and rain and to provide basic facilities like the drinking water, toilets, beds, security, sanitation, etc. and if so, the details of progress thereof; and
(b) whether it is a fact that complaints have been received regarding lack of facilities, cleanliness and maintenance in some night shelters for not meeting the prescribed standards and if so, the action being taken for their monitoring, grievance redressal and improvement?

records.title: Apparel schemes under 'Make in India' program in textiles sector
details:
(a) whether any special schemes have been implemented under the Make in India programme to enhance domestic production in the textile and apparel sector, if so, the progress achieved till date in domestic production, investment, and employment generation; and
(b) the steps taken by Government to reduce import dependence, to promote technical textiles and high value-added products and enable the Indian textile industry to compete globally and the positive outcomes thereof?

records.title: State Development Coordination and Monitoring Committee (DISHA)
Opening of Balwadi in schools
Shortage of RIG and ARV injections
details:
(a) whether the production of Rabies Immunoglobulin (RIG) and Anti-Rabies Vaccine (ARV) injections for the treatment of Rabies in the country is less than the requirement, yet they are being exported; and
(b) if so, the details of their production and export in the last three years?
bpn

records.title: Increasing substance abuse and addiction in youth
details:
(a) whether any assessment has been conducted regarding the rising substance abuse and the number of addicted youths, adolescents and children in the country, particularly in Bihar, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) whether Government is implementing any special scheme at the national level and in Bihar to prevent substance abuse, expand the number of de-addiction centers, conduct public awareness campaigns and strengthen mental health services for treatment and rehabilitation, if so, the details thereof?
J

records.title: Preservation of Siddha system of medicine
details:
(a) whether any specific scheme/programme is being implemented by Government for the preservation, expansion and promotion of the Siddha system of medicine in the country, if so, the number of Siddha institutions, practitioners, research centres and beneficiaries across the country; and
(b) the expenditure incurred on the development, research, drug manufacturing and public health services of Siddha medicine in the last three years and the major benefits received by the general public therefrom?
bpn

records.title: Electric buses to strengthen urban public transport in major cities of Bihar
details:
(a) whether any plan has been approved or proposed for operating electric buses (EV buses) to strengthen urban public transport in major cities of the State of Bihar on the lines of Delhi, if so, the details thereof; and 
(b) the cities in Bihar that have been included or are proposed to be included under the said plan along with the details of number of EV buses, financial support and the expected timelines thereof?

records.title: Safety protocols during transportation of fly ash
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that the prescribed environmental and safety protocols (covering, dust control, leakage prevention etc.) are not being fully followed at many places during transportation of fly ash from thermal power plants to road projects; and
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government to monitor such cases, take action against the culprits and ensure strict compliance with the protocols in the future?
bs

records.title: CNG and City Gas Distribution (CGD) networks in the State of Bihar
Religious sites located at railway stations/premises on land owned by Indian Railways
Lost luggage of Railways passengers
details:
(a) whether the passenger belongings lost in Indian Railways are recovered by the Railway Protection Force/GRP, if so, the number of cases in which lost belongings were recovered during the last three years, zone-wise along with the number of cases in which the belongings were returned to their rightful claimants; and
(b) the number of unclaimed belongings during the same period, zone-wise and the procedure adopted by the Railways for disposal/auction of such unclaimed belongings?

records.title: Sports infrastructure in Bihar
details:
(a) the number of sports complexes, stadiums, multipurpose halls and rural sports infrastructure projects approved, completed and pending in Bihar under Khelo India Scheme during the last five years, along with the details of funds approved and expenditure incurred, district-wise; and
(b) the number of youths in the State identified as national/international players, trained and selected for sports scholarships and the reasons for State’s comparatively weaker performance vis-à-vis other States and the time-bound action plan prepared to improve the same?

Amount paid to private hospitals unde AB-PMJAY

(b) whether any complaints have been received regarding irregularities in the above payments, pending claims or quality-related issues, if so, the details of actions taken thereon?

details: Clubbed question in this member’s official feed

records.title: Promotion of integrative cancer care through Ayush
details:
(a) whether research is being conducted on medicines for the treatment of cancer and diabetes (sugar) through Ayurvedic, Siddha, Unani and other traditional medical systems with the aim of developing remedies that have minimal side effects and effectively address the root cause of the disease, if so, the details of the major research conducted so far along with the findings thereof; and
(b) whether the medicines developed based on these researches have been approved for scientific evaluation, clinical trials and public use, if so, the number of such medicines currently being used in treatment and the benefits received by patients therefrom?

records.title: Metro project in Gaya and Muzaffarpur cities
details:
(a) whether a metro project is being considered in Gaya and Muzaffarpur cities; and
(b) if so, the details of the feasibility study and the timeline?
bpn

records.title: Higher prices of food items in comparison to the general market
details:
(a) whether Government is aware of the fact that not only bottled drinking water but also other food items being sold at various airports in the country are at higher prices/different MRPs than in the general market and if so, the details of the agencies/contractors responsible therefor; and
(b) whether any concrete policies, monitoring mechanisms or price control guidelines have been implemented to ensure availability of food and beverages at reasonable prices, prevention of MRP violations at airports and complaint redressal in the interest of passengers, if so, the details thereof?

records.title: (clubbed) Implementation of IndiaAI Mission
details: Clubbed question in this member’s official feed

records.title: Climate change induced hormonal imbalance in crops
details:
(a) whether climate change induced hormonal imbalance in crops, especially mango, has increased the problem of premature fruit drop; and
(b) Government's action plan to address the same?

records.title: Utilisation of donations/offerings
details:
(a) whether all religious sites in the country, functioning under the Central or State Governments/autonomous boards, maintain accounts of donations/offerings received and if so, the details of donations received during the last three years, location-wise; and
(b) the heads under which the above donations have been utilised and whether a uniform mechanism for transparency, audit and public disclosure has been implemented therefor?

records.title: Drug-addicted children
details:
(a) whether Government is implementing any special scheme/programme to identify drug-addicted minor children roaming on roads, footpaths, railway and bus stations and to provide them with de-addiction treatment, protection and hand them over to their families, if so, the details thereof; and
(b) the number of such children identified and reunited with their families or sent to rehabilitation centres during the last three years and till date, State-wise details thereof?

records.title: Establishment of trauma centres near national highways
details:
(a) the State-wise details of trauma centres established near national highways/major roads, particularly the number of trauma centres operational in the State of Bihar along with the details of their functionality Status, available doctors, beds, ambulances and emergency services; and
(b) whether Government is implementing any action plan to establish new trauma centres, strengthen existing centres and expand rapid emergency medical services in view of the shortage of trauma care facilities in Bihar, if so, the details thereof?

records.title: Implementation of schemes in Bihar under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan
details:
(a) whether the progress of implementation of schemes related to industries, MSMEs, start-ups, food processing and skill development in the State of Bihar under the Atmanirbhar Bharat Abhiyan has been assessed, if so, the details of the achievements made so far; and
(b) whether Government has approved any special package, project or additional assistance in Bihar to boost investment, employment generation and local production, if so, the details thereof?
bpn

records.title: Financial support to SAIL
details:
(a) whether Government is coordinating with banks/financial institutions to arrange financial support and bank loans to increase the production capacity of Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL); and
(b) if so, the details of the major decisions taken along with the proposed assistance in this regard?

records.title: Establishment of a film city in Bihar
details:
(a) whether Government considers that the film industry can contribute to the overall development of Bihar; and
(b) if so, whether any proposal is under consideration for setting up a film city in Bihar?

records.title: Industrial Tribunal-cum-Labour Courts
details:
(a) the number of complaints/cases received in the Central Government Industrial Tribunal-cum-Labour Courts from the year 2023 till date, the number of cases disposed of along with the number of cases still pending; and
(b) the concrete steps taken by Government for expeditious disposal of pending cases related to Bihar and the status of vacancies in Tribunals along with condition of infrastructure therein?

records.title: Menace of stray monkeys
details:
(a) whether Government is aware of problems caused to citizens, farmers and public property due to increasing number of stray monkeys in urban and rural areas and if so, the details thereof, State-wise; and
(b) whether Government is promoting monkey sterilization programmes, rehabilitation measures, conservation of natural habitats and awareness campaigns to mitigate human–animal conflict and if so, the details of positive outcomes achieved so far and the future action plan proposed for monkey menace?

records.title: Economically and socially Backward Classes (EBCs) within the OBC category
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that in several states like Bihar, Jharkhand, and Karnataka, the Economically and socially Backward Classes (EBCs) within the OBC category are being identified separately and provided with special reservations/benefits, if so, the details of such States and the facilities being provided therein; and
(b) whether Government, in light of the such experiences, has conducted or proposes to conduct any study at the national level on a policy of separating EBCs from OBCs for extending benefits, if so, the details thereof?

records.title: Licensed fertilizer sales centres in the country.
details:
(a) the number of licensed fertilizer sales centres in the country as on date, State-wise, particularly in the State of Bihar; and
(b) the number of centres converted into Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samriddhi Kendras (PMKSK) out of these centres?

records.title: Additional seat charges from passengers during online check-in
details:
(a) whether Government is aware that additional seat charges are being collected from passengers booked under the same PNR during online check-in; and
(b) if so, the steps taken to prevent such unfair charges?

records.title: Digital apps and tools developed by India
details:
(a) the number of digital applications and tools developed by India that are being used by other countries as on date; and
(b) the names of such applications and tools, their areas of use and a brief account of their international adoption?

records.title: Provisions for workers in Labour Codes
details:
(a) the key provisions implemented so far for the workers in the organized and unorganized sectors under the new Labour Codes and the changes they have brought about in terms of wages, employment security and social security coverage; and
(b) the impact of implementation of the new Labour Codes on migrant and unorganized workers in the State of Bihar and the specific steps taken in the State for registration, social security and protection of rights of such workers?

records.title: Improvement in consular services for Indians
Mid-day meal under National Education Policy, 2020
details:
(a) whether National Education Policy, 2020 recommends providing breakfast along with the Mid-day meal; and
(b) if so, the steps taken by the Centre and the States for its implementation?

records.title: Production and import of Urea
details:
(a) the details of domestically produced and imported urea in its ordinary and neem/sulfur coated forms in the country, year-wise; and
(b) the schemes being implemented by Government to achieve self-reliance in the urea sector?

records.title: GOBARdhan Scheme
details:
(a) the updated details of the projects approved and implemented so far under the GOBARdhan scheme, State-wise; and
(b) the impact of this scheme on bioenergy production, employment generation, and rural income so far?

records.title: Participation of top companies in job fairs in Bihar
details:
(a) the number of top companies in the country that have participated, so far, in the job fairs organized in Bihar and the number of youth who have received employment and apprenticeship/training opportunities through such companies; and 
(b) the special policy, incentive or coordination mechanism that has been developed to increase the participation of top companies in job fairs organized in Bihar and the action plan to strengthen it in future?

records.title: Identifying young scientists and encouraging research
details:
(a) the schemes/programmes being implemented by the Central Government to identify young scientists and to encourage discovery and research in the country and the number of young scientists who have been selected under such schemes/programmes during the last five years; and
(b) whether Government is providing any special assistance, scholarships or mentorship to connect the youth of rural and backward/aspirational districts of Bihar with scientific research and if so, the details thereof?

records.title: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
details:
(a) whether State-specific targets, allocations and implementation strategies have been determined for the State of Bihar to increase employment capacity in manufacturing and other sectors, to connect local youth with skill-based employment and to strengthen social security (EPF/ESI, etc. ) for workers out of the total outlay of 99,446 crore rupees under the Pradhan Mantra Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana (PMVBRY) during the registration period from 01.08.2025 to 31.07.2027; and
(b) the amount that has been approved/spent for Bihar under this scheme, so far?

records.title: Empowering handloom sector of Bihar
details:
(a) the initiatives taken by the Ministry to strengthen the weaver handloom sectors of Bihar through design intervention, common facility center, e-market link, financial assistance, skill upgradation and silk development programmes; and
(b) whether any target has been set to increase production and exports through the initiatives undertaken?

records.title: Conservation, restoration and upgradation of tourist facilities in Bihar
details:
(a) the details of projects approved during the last three years for conservation, restoration and upgradation of tourist facilities at protected monuments in Bihar, particularly those related to Nalanda, Vaishali, Vikramshila and Pataliputra and the amount spent on these projects, so far; and
(b) whether the Ministry has considered including lesser-known but historically important sites in Bihar in the list of protected monuments of national importance and if so, the details of identification of such sites, the status of proposals and the proposed steps for their conservation?

records.title: Policy on School Bag, 2020
details:
(a) whether it is a fact that despite the clear guidelines of the New Education Policy, 2020 and the 'Policy on School Bag, 2020' issued by Government, the weight of students' bags in most schools still exceeds the prescribed limit, especially in primary classes where children have to carry heavy bags daily; and
(b) whether there is any laxity in effective implementation of these policies by schools, if so, whether Government, in coordination with State Governments, would formulate a concrete action plan to ensure strict inspections, penalties and mandatory compliance?

records.title: Online financial fraud
details:
(a) whether there is a continuous rise in cases of online financial fraud in the country, affecting citizens' savings, the security of digital transactions and trust in the financial system, if so, whether any high-level review has been conducted to examine the causes, methods and misuse of new technologies in this regard; and
(b) the concrete measures implemented to combat online financial fraud, take action against international cyber networks and strengthen citizens' digital security, whether a clear target has been set to reduce complaints and financial losses through these measures?

records.title: Performance of Bihar in key areas like education, health, sanitation and poverty alleviation
Complaints of corruption against Railway officials
Infrastructure for electronics manufacturing and digital skills development in Bihar
Akhara God scheme
Grant given to Gram Panchayats in the State of Bihar
Adverse health effects on children from excessive consumption of unsafe processed cream-based food
details:
(a) whether Government is aware that the filling used in “crema” biscuits available in the market primarily consists of processed vegetable oil, sugar, artificial flavours and colours, that may have adverse effects on children’s health, if so, the scientific evaluations or studies conducted in this regard; and
(b) whether Government is considering stricter monitoring, health warnings or restrictions on the use of artificial ingredients in such products in order to protect children from excessive consumption of unsafe processed cream-based food items?

records.title: CSR Activities under Section 135 of the Companies Act, 2013
Funds utilized in CIL & NLCIL under CSR policy
details:
(a) the amount spent and the projects on which CSR funds were utilized during the last three years in the aspirational and backward blocks of the State of Bihar by PSUs, especially Coal India Limited (CIL) and NLC India Limited (NLCIL) under Government, which are obligated under their CSR policy to spend primarily in their local operational areas; and
(b) whether any policy amendment or special provision is being proposed to increase CSR allocation in non-operational States like the State of Bihar in the future?

records.title: Progress of under-construction rural houses under PMAY-G
details:
(a) whether, in view of the current progress of under construction rural houses under Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G), any quick action plan or special strategy has been formulated to achieve the target before the stipulated deadline; and
(b) if so, whether Government is making coordinated efforts with the States to increase the pace of construction, streamline the provisions related to material availability, payment process and land verification?
